summary: Specifies a generic mechanism to extend IGMPv3 and Multicast Listener Discovery version 2 (MLDv2) using a list of TLVs (Type, Length, Value). That makes it easier to add new information to these multicast group membership messages in the future. It is a standards-track specification.

eli5.summary: These messages are short forms with no spare space. This adds a place at the end to attach extra labeled notes, each saying what it is and how long it is.

questions: what is tlv extension for mldv2
